summary: SOS Limited, a Cayman-incorporated, Qingdao-based crypto/security broker listed on NYSE (Form 6-K equivalent of a US current report), disclosed a September 18, 2026 Regulation S securities purchase agreement with non-US persons for 19,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.18 per share, raising roughly $3.42 million gross for data-center development, working capital and general corporate purposes. Closing conditions include NYSE approval of the supplemental listing application and representations being accurate. No advisor, board recommendation, premium or registration rights were disclosed; shares are unregistered under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg S. Watch dilution and NYSE listing clearance.
